Descriptive diagnostics for an explicit observation process

etr_observation_process_data.Rd

Construct a candidate-sample denominator and describe retention, support, and associations with candidate-time variables and past observations.

Usage

etr_observation_process_data(frame, curve_column, time_column,
  observed_column, group_column = NULL, candidate_predictors = character(),
  predictor_sources = NULL, coordinate_columns = character(),
  time_unit = "unknown", coordinate_system = "unknown", provenance = list())

etr_diagnose_observation_process(process, predictors = NULL,
  history_predictors = character(), eccentricity_reference = NULL,
  risk_set = "all_candidates", time_basis = "linear", time_bins = NULL,
  association_bins = 4L, low_support_threshold = 0.10)

etr_observation_process_frame(result, table = "associations")

etr_observation_process_reporting_text(result)

Arguments

frame

Data frame with one row per scheduled or otherwise explicit candidate sample. Each curve has a strictly increasing time sequence in the supplied rows.

curve_column, time_column, observed_column

Names of the curve identifier, candidate time, and binary observation indicator columns.

group_column

Optional metadata column for group summaries.

candidate_predictors

Columns available at every candidate row.

predictor_sources

Named list or vector declaring "candidate_time", "design", or "external_candidate_time" per predictor.

coordinate_columns

Optional pair of observed coordinate columns with finite values on retained rows and missing values on unretained rows after decimal numeric conversion.

time_unit, coordinate_system, provenance

Source metadata.

process

An explicit denominator from etr_observation_process_data().

predictors

Subset of declared candidate-time predictors. The default uses every declared predictor.

history_predictors

Requested prior-history columns. Available names are previous_observed_x, previous_observed_y, previous_observed_eccentricity, previous_observed_speed, time_since_last_observed, preceding_observed_run_length, and preceding_missing_run_length.

eccentricity_reference

Optional finite pair of numeric or decimal-text coordinate values.

risk_set

Evaluate all candidate rows or those immediately following an observed candidate within a curve, using "after_observed".

time_basis

"linear" includes a descriptive time association. NULL omits it.

time_bins, association_bins

Number of equal-width bins, increasing edge vector, or NULL.

low_support_threshold

Numeric or decimal-text observed fraction threshold in \([0,1]\).

result

An observation-process diagnostic result.

table

One of "global", "curves", "groups", "time", "support", "associations", "profiles", "failures", or "candidates".

Details

Time summaries use the selected risk set. Regional support uses the full candidate denominator and identifies empty, zero-observation, and low-support regions. Predictor associations summarize observed versus missing rows. History variables use earlier observations within the same curve. Regional counts use the original bin edges. Displayed interval endpoints follow the pandas decimal rounding convention on the tested finite domain. Original candidate columns retain their order and history columns use a fixed native order.

Value

The constructor returns an etr_observation_process_data record. The diagnostic function returns an etr_observation_process_diagnostic record with summaries, failure rows, and provenance. The frame and reporting functions return a data frame and a character string, respectively.
